import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and clean style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))

# Create a scatter plot (bubble chart) to visualize three dimensions:
# x-axis: Hour of the day
# y-axis: Transaction amount
# color (hue): Transaction type
# size: Transaction amount (to emphasize larger transactions)
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size='amount',
    sizes=(150, 1500),  # Control the min and max size of the bubbles
    alpha=0.8,          # Set transparency for better visibility
    edgecolor='black',  # Add an edge to bubbles for clarity
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=ax
)

# Enhance the plot with titles and labels
ax.set_title('Analysis of Transaction Amount by Hour and Type', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)

# Set x-axis to cover a full 24-hour cycle for context
ax.set_xlim(-1, 24)
ax.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 2)) # Set ticks for every 2 hours

# Improve the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# The legend combines hue and size, so we can give it a single title
ax.legend(handles, labels, title='Transaction Details', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Ensure the layout is tight and fits all elements
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1]) # Adjust layout to make room for the legend outside the plot

# Save the generated visualization to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')

# Close the plot to free up memory
plt.close(fig)
